recentItems.title: Brewers THRILLING Comeback! Jeter, Papi & A-Rod Break Down Gritty Game 2 Win vs Rays in World Series
recentItems.description: Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez, David Ortiz and Kevin Burkhardt break down the Milwaukee Brewers thrilling comeback win over the Tampa Bay Rays in World Series Game 2. The crew is also joined by Brewers’ Sal Frelick and William Contreras.

recentItems.title: Milwaukee’s Haunted Hotel Mystery Solved? Big Papi Isn’t Sticking Around to Find Out
recentItems.description: Kevin Burkardt, Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez and David Ortiz looked into the ghost stories surrounding Milwaukee’s haunted hotels during the World Series.
